source: JoyPro curated on the maker's photo (2026-10-11), the throttle box alone seen from the pilot's side, slightly from the right and from above: four levers (black SPEED BRAKE, blue, red, flat black SLAT FLAP) in the slots, PARK BRK lever, L ENG / R ENG switches and the gear lever with the ring knob at the front
mappingSource: catalog honeycomb.json (sources https://flyhoneycomb.com/products/foxtrot-takeoff-kit, https://flyhoneycomb.com/pages/downloads): four exchangeable levers with reverse detents, parking brake lever, gear lever; no input numbers and no USB id (Honeycomb's input maps were not retrievable)
note: Levers are numbered by slot from the pilot's left to right (lever 1 = SPEED BRAKE slot, lever 4 = SLAT FLAP slot); this is the slot order, not a published axis order. Lever tops are exchangeable, so colours vary. The reverse detents are virtual (lever pulled past its stop), not separate controls. The gear lever is identified by its ring (wheel-shaped) knob, as on the Echo; the L ENG / R ENG toggle switches are visible but are not catalog parts (catalog note mentions engine switches).
